entries.target: A short range attack that deals damage to 3 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: Use your newfound powers to enchant your weapon with pure Chaos and strike at your foes. If you are not Chaorrupted, you apply Chaos Affliction, increasing your outgoing damage by 1% for 12 seconds, stacks to 30. If you are Chaorrupted, applies Chaos Blight, increasing your outgoing damage by 6% for 12 seconds, stacks to 15.

entries.target: A long range status skill that applies to 6 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: Chaos is the unpredictable power shrouded in mystery. Deal no damage and randomly applies up to 4 effects.
entries.evidence: Enigma Rank Needed: 2 Mana Cost: 13 Mana Cooldown: 4 Seconds Type: Magical Range: A long range status skill that applies to 6 hostile targets. Description: Chaos is the unpredictable power shrouded in mystery. Deal no damage and randomly applies up to 4 effects. Anguished: +50% damage taken (40%) Delusion: -40% Hit Chance (40%) Impasse: -40% Dodge (40%) Courageous: -40% Outgoing Damage to self (8%) Effects last for 10 seconds.

entries.target: A short range status skill that applies to yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Absorb the chaotic energy around you to mend your wounds, applying a HoT for 6 seconds. The absorbed energy also has a 50% chance to form a barrier around you, reducing incoming damage by 65% for 8 seconds.
entries.evidence: Surge Rank Needed: 3 Mana Cost: 24 Mana Cooldown: 15 Seconds Type: Hybrid Range: A short range status skill that applies to yourself. Description: Absorb the chaotic energy around you to mend your wounds, applying a HoT for 6 seconds. The absorbed energy also has a 50% chance to form a barrier around you, reducing incoming damage by 65% for 8 seconds. Note: The HoT gets stronger with each stack of Chaos Affliction and Chaos Blight you currently have.
